definition: This dimension controls how often players encounter death in the game, influencing the pacing and intensity of the experience. It varies from high-frequency death scenarios, where player characters die frequently, to low-frequency situations, where death is a rare occurrence and players can progress further before facing permanent loss.
exclusion_criteria: Games where death is non-existent or does not affect gameplay
Games with respawn mechanics that allow players to continue without significant loss
inclusion_criteria: Games with varying death rates based on player skill or decisions
Games that implement different difficulty levels affecting death frequency
title: Death Frequency Variation
